name: quil

about.description: The quil package provides tools for constructing, manipulating, parsing, and printing Quil programs.
The quil package provides tools for constructing, manipulating, parsing, and printing Quil programs.

raw_meta_yaml:
schema_version: 1

context:
  version: "0.37.2"
  # quil-cli version shipped in the quil-rs tag
  cli_version: "0.14.2"

  qemu_arch: ${{ host_platform | replace("linux-64", "x86_64") | replace("linux-", "") }}
  is_qemuable: ${{ (host_platform != build_platform) and (host_platform in ["linux-64", "linux-aarch64", "linux-ppc64le", "linux-riscv64", "linux-s390x"]) }}
  qemu_pkg: ${{ ('qemu-execve-' ~ qemu_arch ~ '[version=">=11", build_number=">=12"]') if is_qemuable else '' }}

recipe:
  name: quil-split
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  url: https://github.com/rigetti/quil-rs/archive/refs/tags/quil-rs/v${{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: 5d04289742bbc0bfef3060e52caf99372978b2784d7842ade74b4dc87ed69350

build:
  number: 5

outputs:
  - staging:
      name: quil-wheels
    build:
      script:
        - pushd quil-rs
        - maturin build --release --strip --compatibility off --out ../wheels
        - popd
        - pushd quil-cli
        - maturin build --release --strip --compatibility off --out ../wheels
        - popd
        - cargo-bundle-licenses --format yaml --output THIRDPARTY.yml
        - if: win
          then: '%PYTHON% -m pip install quil quil-cli --no-build-isolation --no-deps --only-binary :all: --no-index --find-links=wheels --prefix "%PREFIX%" -vv'
          else: '"${PYTHON}" -m pip install quil quil-cli --no-build-isolation --no-deps --only-binary :all: --no-index --find-links=wheels --prefix "${PREFIX}" -vv'
    requirements:
      build:
        - ${{ compiler('rust') }}
        - ${{ compiler('c') }}
        - ${{ stdlib('c') }}
        - cargo-bundle-licenses
        - if: build_platform != host_platform
          then:
            - cross-python_${{ host_platform }}
            - maturin >=1.9.4,<2.0.0
            - python
      host:
        - maturin >=1.9.4,<2.0.0
        - pip
        - python

  - package:
      name: quil
      version: ${{ version }}
    inherit: quil-wheels
    build:
      files:
        - "**/site-packages/quil/**"
        - "**/site-packages/quil-*.dist-info/**"
      dynamic_linking:
        missing_dso_allowlist:
          - if: ppc64le
            then:
              - "*/ld64.so.2"
    requirements:
      build:
        - ${{ compiler('c') }}
        - ${{ stdlib('c') }}
      host:
        - python
      run:
        - numpy >=1.26
        - python
      run_exports:
        - ${{ pin_subpackage('quil', upper_bound='x.x') }}
    tests:
      - if: not is_qemuable
        then:
          - python:
              imports:
                - quil
              pip_check: true
          - files:
              source:
                - quil-rs/tests_py/
            requirements:
              run:
                - pytest
                - syrupy
                - hypothesis
            script:
              - pytest quil-rs/tests_py
        else:
          - files:
              source:
                - quil-rs/tests_py/
            requirements:
              build:
                - ${{ qemu_pkg }}
                - sysroot_${{ host_platform }}
              run:
                - pip
                - pytest
                - syrupy
                - hypothesis
            script:
              - test -n "${QEMU_EXECVE}" || { echo "[FAIL] QEMU_EXECVE not set" >&2; exit 1; }
              - test -d "${QEMU_LD_PREFIX}" || { echo "[FAIL] QEMU_LD_PREFIX is not a directory" >&2; exit 1; }
              - '"${QEMU_EXECVE}" "${PREFIX}/bin/python" -c "import quil"'
              - '"${QEMU_EXECVE}" "${PREFIX}/bin/python" -m pip check'
              - '"${QEMU_EXECVE}" "${PREFIX}/bin/python" -m pytest quil-rs/tests_py'

  - package:
      name: quil-cli
      version: ${{ cli_version }}
    inherit: quil-wheels
    build:
      files:
        - if: win
          then: Scripts/quil-cli.exe
          else: bin/quil-cli
        - "**/site-packages/quil_cli-*.dist-info/**"
    requirements:
      build:
        - ${{ compiler('c') }}
        - ${{ stdlib('c') }}
      host:
        - python
    tests:
      - if: not is_qemuable
        then:
          - script:
              - quil-cli --help
        else:
          - requirements:
              build:
                - ${{ qemu_pkg }}
                - sysroot_${{ host_platform }}
            script:
              - '"${QEMU_EXECVE}" "${PREFIX}/bin/quil-cli" --help'

  - package:
      name: quil_cli
      version: ${{ cli_version }}
    requirements:
      run:
        - ${{ pin_subpackage('quil-cli', exact=True) }}
    tests:
      - if: not is_qemuable
        then:
          - script:
              - quil-cli --help
        else:
          - requirements:
              build:
                - ${{ qemu_pkg }}
                - sysroot_${{ host_platform }}
            script:
              - '"${QEMU_EXECVE}" "${PREFIX}/bin/quil-cli" --help'
    about:
      license_file:
        - LICENSE

about:
  homepage: https://github.com/rigetti/quil-rs
  summary: Quil Parser & Program Builder
  description: |
    The quil package provides tools for constructing, manipulating, parsing, and printing Quil programs.
  license: Apache-2.0
  license_file:
    - LICENSE
    - THIRDPARTY.yml
  documentation: https://rigetti.github.io/quil-rs/quil.html

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - MementoRC
